deadline.value: The deadline for Fall 2027 (August start) is December 1, 2026; the program admits once a year.
deadline.quote: December 1 for Fall. This is for an August start; program accepts new students once a year.

gre_general.value: The school does not require the GRE to apply.
gre_general.quote: We do not require the GRE to apply to our graduate program.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Biology Test in May 2021.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Biology Test and the GRE Literature in English Test were discontinued in May 2021.

toefl_min.value: The department requires an internet TOEFL of 85, above the Graduate Studies minimum.
toefl_min.quote: Minimum English proficiency: Paper TOEFL 565, Internet TOEFL 85, IELTS 6.5

supervisor.value: The page asks applicants to name up to four faculty but does not say an agreement is needed first.

funding.value: The page does not say whether admitted PhD students are funded.

entry_route.value: The page does not say whether a master's is needed before the PhD.

notes: Biology page lists fee waiver requests by November 15 for applicants not eligible for the listed exemptions.
